metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that can give both quick AND long-lasting relief for nerve pain in the feet. 

These exercises are especially good for helping with tingling, numbness, and aches from neuropathy (in the feet).  

Let us know how they work for you!
